traps.truth: Deku is his successor and student, not his son.

traps.truth: He was the eighth user; Deku is the ninth.

traps.ask: Endeavor was your master, wasn't he?
traps.truth: His master was Nana Shimura; Endeavor was his rival hero.

traps.ask: You beat All For One at U.A., right?
